title: “It's Not Just Hate”: A Multi-Dimensional Perspective on Detecting Harmful Speech Online

bias_targets.methodology: Collecting and annotating a dataset of US and UK tweets focused on immigration with fine-grained labels for incivility (profanities, insults, outrage, character assassination) and intolerance (discrimination, hostility), followed by fine-tuning and evaluating language models (RoBERTa, BERTweet) to detect these multidimensional aspects of harmful speech.
